newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Indian murderer, Pakistani for drugs.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Indian murderer, Pakistani for drugs.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded an Indian man on Monday for stabbing an Indian woman to death and executed a Pakistani national for smuggling drugs into the kingdom, the interior ministry reported.

A ministry statement carried by official Saudi television said the Indian man was beheaded in Riyadh for killing the woman in her home after she refused his advances. The ministry said he had stabbed her several times with a kitchen knife.
The interior ministry said the Pakistani man was executed for smuggling heroin, bringing to eight the number of Pakistanis executed on drugs charges in the past month.
A ministry statement carried by state-run Saudi radio and monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation said the man was also beheaded in the capital Riyadh.

The executions raised to 56 the number of people put to death this year in Saudi Arabia, which enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drugs smugglers and other criminals. It executed a total of 68 people in 1996.
